thread:
Priya: Heads-up — Prospective cust (GlobalPay) has a long RFP around key custody. They require: BYO HSM (on-prem Thales), quarterly rotation, cross-region replication (EU->US), HSM attestation (FIPS 140-2 level 3), no plaintext key escrow, and that all key ops are logged to their Splunk. They asked for a 3-week POC and a line-item for an HSM connector license in the quote.

Omar: Clarify replication: do they want active-active or active-passive? That changes connector + latency work. Also need to know whether replication of key material is allowed or if only wrapped copies.

Liz: Security: we'll require their HSM admin to provide attestation reports + HSM certs. For "no escrow" — we can avoid holding plaintext but must have a wrapped backup plan; legal will need to sign off on limited backup acceptance. Splunk forwarding: we can ship audit logs over a secure syslog/HTTPS endpoint.

Priya: Sales asks: what's a reasonable PS estimate and delta to hosted pricing for connector + HSM license? Also whether we can include rotation automation as managed service.

Omar: Rough eng estimate for POC + connector: 60-100 hours depending on Thales variants + network setup. One-off connector license $10k, POC PS fee $8k. Managed rotation add-on $3k/mo if we do orchestration + rotation runbook + 24/7 support. These are placeholders until eng confirms.

Liz: Onboarding checklist posted: https://redwood.internal/sales/kms/onboard-checklist

security-bot: Security questionnaire auto-fill: "BYO HSM supported; plaintext never stored; rotation supported; audit logs exportable to customer SIEM." Review required by security team.

Priya: They also flagged an enterprise blocker — compliance wants key custody flow diagram and explanation of where DEKs live during model serving. Can we produce that for the SOC review? @Omar @Liz

Omar: I'll sketch a flow: client HSM KEK -> Redwood envelope key -> DEKs in runtime memory (wrapped at rest) -> optional short-term cache TTL. I'll add notes about HSM call latency and failover.

Liz: Also: cross-border replication triggers export control checks (EU data staying in EU only?). Legal said to confirm jurisdictions before POC.

eng-oncall: FYI — if we connect to on-prem Thales we'll need an ops runbook for credential rotation and a maintenance window plan. Add to POC scope.

Priya: Action items: 1) get HSM model + regions, 2) provide SOW + ballpark pricing, 3) produce custody diagram and rotation runbook draft, 4) security to review legal export controls. Target: SOW + pricing by next Tue.

Omar: I'll start the thread for DEK lifetime examples and include perf numbers from our last CloudHSM trial.

Priya: Great. I'll follow up with the customer to pin down active/passive replication requirement.
